mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, type, company, model, fuel, mileage, battery_kwh AS batteryKwh, range_km AS rangeKm, g_per_km AS gPerKm, wh_per_km AS whPerKm
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vehicles WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM vehicles WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicles (user_id, type, company, model, fuel, mileage, battery_kwh, range_km, g_per_km, wh_per_km) VALUES (#{v.userId}, #{v.type}, #{v.company}, #{v.model}, #{v.fuel}, #{v.mileage}, #{v.batteryKwh}, #{v.rangeKm}, #{v.gPerKm}, #{v.whPerKm})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM vehicles WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
